sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:67053
Court No. - 73

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 55401 of 2023
Applicant :- Chota @ Irshad

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Quasim Khan,Shams Uz Zaman
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Heard Shri Ms. Amrita Kashyap, Advocate holding brief of Shri Shams Uz Zaman, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S. B. Maurya, learned AGA-I for the State-respondent.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.264 of 2022, under Sections 420, 307 I.P.C. and Sections 3/5/8 Cow Slaughter Act, Police Station Doghat, District Baghpat, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against co-accused Amit Kumar and 3-4 unknown persons and according to the FIR when police was checking the vehicle then driver of the vehicle tried to crush them and thereafter when police apprehended the vehicle then from the vehicle 150 kg.
beef was recovered.
It is further mentioned in the FIR that the co-accused Amit Kumar was the owner of the vehicle.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant was not named in the FIR and during investigation, one Dilshad was made accused and when his statement was recorded by the Chota @ Irshad vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97347161/
1 Investigating Officer then he disclosed the name of the applicant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. She further submits except the statement of co-accused Dilshad, there is no other evidence against the applicant on record.
6. She further submits that the applicant is not having any criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 13.10.2023.
7. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the argument on facts advanced by learned counsel for the applicant.
8. I have heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. From the record, it reflects that applicant was neither arrested at spot nor any recovery was made from his possession and it appears that during investigation on the basis of statement of co-accused Dilshad, he was made accused in the present matter.
10. Further, applicant is not having any criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 13.10.2023.

11. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
12. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

13. Let the applicant- Chota @ Irshad, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
14.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

15. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the Chota @ Irshad vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97347161/
2 merits of the case during trial.
